caption: The drawing consists of an ornate, rectangular frame rendered in shades of black and gray on an off-white background. The topmost part of the frame features a basket filled with flowers and leaves, flanked by symmetrical scrollwork. The main rectangular section is divided into three vertical parts, with the central section being the largest. The left and right sections contain vertically oriented, stylized architectural elements with scrolls and leaf motifs. The central panel contains an intricate, symmetrical design of acanthus leaves and scrolling vines, with a centrally placed winged figure. The figure is depicted in a side profile with one leg raised and head turned downward; it has wings spread and is holding a bow in its left hand. The entirety of the design is highly decorative, with dense foliate and scroll patterns occupying the spaces around the central figure and along the borders. The drawing is monochromatic, executed in detailed pencil or ink linework.
title: Cast Ornament
